import sys
from airflow.models import Variable

path_utils = Variable.get("PATH_DAG_UTILS", default_var="./dags/dags_utils")
sys.path.append(path_utils)

import factory_zc_zp
import factory_zr


P_RUTA_MOTOR = "/home/cda-motor-ingesta-datos/tablas-v2"
P_RUTA_TT = "/home/cda-cla-act-gruposeconomicos-datos/transformacion"
P_RUTA_DP = "/home/cda-bian-prd-loansdeposits-datos/transformaciones"

P_ID_GRUPO_INGESTA = "P_ID_GRUPO_INGESTA"

p_ruta_primaria_ds = Variable.get(
    "P_RUTA_PRIMARIA_DATASETS", default_var="/ruta"
).rstrip("/")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DAG 1: Ingesta a Zona Curada con factory_zr
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
zr_config = {
    "dag_id": "dag_acp_act_cur_grupos_economicos_zr",
    "codigo_malla": "ACP_ACT_001",
    "schedule": "@daily",
    "flujos": [
        {
            "workflow_name": "pl-ingesta-Uti-MotorTablas",
            "id_ingesta": "CLA_T20OGE32_C",
            "talla": "XS",
            "nombre_tabla": "ZC_BP_Cla_Act_TT_GruposEconomicos",
        },
        {
            "workflow_name": "pl-ingesta-Uti-MotorTablas",
            "id_ingesta": "CLA_T20EIN31_C",
            "talla": "XS",
            "nombre_tabla": "ZC_BP_Cla_Act_TT_ObservacionesGrupoEconomico",
        },
        {
            "workflow_name": "pl-ingesta-Uti-MotorTablas",
            "id_ingesta": "CLA_T20IGE12_C",
            "talla": "XS",
            "nombre_tabla": "ZC_BP_Cla_Act_TT_IntegrantesGrupoEconomico",
        },
        {
            "workflow_name": "pl-ingesta-Uti-MotorTablas",
            "id_ingesta": "CLA_T20DTA52_C",
            "talla": "XS",
            "nombre_tabla": "ZC_BP_Cla_Act_TD_GruposEconomicosCatalogo",
        },
    ],
    "tags": [
        "tribe: adm",
        "cell: datos",
        "domain: acp",
        "type: DataZonaCurada",
        "type: zona-cur",
        "type: gruposEconomicos",
        "type: zr",
    ],
    "description": "Ingesta a zona curada de fuentes de grupos economicos.",
    "owner": "data-engineering",
    "depends_on_past": False,
    "email_on_failure": False,
    "email_on_retry": False,
    "retries": 3,
    "retry_delay_minutes": 5,
    "catchup": False,
    "max_active_runs": 1,
    "dagrun_timeout_minutes": 180,
    "start_year": 2026,
    "start_month": 1,
    "start_day": 1,
    "days_back_from": 1,
    "days_back_to": 1,
}


dag_zr = factory_zr.create_dag(zr_config)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DAG 2: TT -> TN -> DP con factory_zc_zp
# Se dispara al publicarse los datasets del DAG ZR.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
zc_zp_config = {
    "dag_id": "dag_acp_act_cur_prd_dp_grupos_economicos",
    "codigo_malla": "ACP_ACT_001",
    "description": (
        "Transformacion TT, carga TN por motor de ingesta y "
        "carga a Data Producto."
    ),
    "owner": "data-engineering",
    "tags": [
        "tribe: adm",
        "cell: datos",
        "domain: acp",
        "type: transformacion_datos",
        "type: zona-cur",
        "type: gruposEconomicos",
        "type: zona-prd",
        "type: dp",
        "type: zc-zp",
    ],
    "schedule": [
        f"{p_ruta_primaria_ds}/ZC_BP_Cla_Act_TD_GruposEconomicosCatalogo",
        f"{p_ruta_primaria_ds}/ZC_BP_Cla_Act_TT_GruposEconomicos",
        f"{p_ruta_primaria_ds}/ZC_BP_Cla_Act_TT_IntegrantesGrupoEconomico",
        f"{p_ruta_primaria_ds}/ZC_BP_Cla_Act_TT_ObservacionesGrupoEconomico",
    ],
    "retries": 3,
    "retry_delay_minutes": 5,
    "max_active_runs": 1,
    "dagrun_timeout_minutes": 180,
    "depends_on_past": False,
    "email_on_failure": False,
    "email_on_retry": False,
    "catchup": False,
    "days_back_from": 1,
    "days_back_to": 1,
    "start_year": 2026,
    "start_month": 1,
    "start_day": 1,
    "flujos": [
        {
            "workflow_name": (
                "pl-transformacion-Acp-Zc-GruposEconomicosIntegrantes"
            ),
            "ruta_grupo": P_RUTA_TT,
            "params_lists": ["M", "TransformationResources"],
            "nombre_tabla": "ZC_BP_Cla_Act_TT_GruposEconomicosConIntegrantes",
            "prioridad": 1,
        },
        {
            "workflow_name": "pl-ingesta-Uti-MotorTablas",
            "ruta_grupo": P_RUTA_MOTOR,
            "params_lists": ["XS", "TransformationResources"],
            "extra_params": [
                {"name": P_ID_GRUPO_INGESTA, "value": "CLA_GRUCONINT"}
            ],
            "nombre_tabla": "ZP_BP_Cla_Act_TN_GruposEconomicosConIntegrantes",
            "prioridad": 2,
        },
        {
            "workflow_name": "pl-transformacion-Acp-Dp-GruposEconomicos",
            "ruta_grupo": P_RUTA_DP,
            "params_lists": ["M", "TransformationResources"],
            "nombre_tabla": "DP_BP_Cla_Act_GruposEconomicos",
            "prioridad": 3,
        },
    ],
}


dag_zc_zp = factory_zc_zp.create_dag(zc_zp_config)

globals()[zr_config["dag_id"]] = dag_zr
globals()[zc_zp_config["dag_id"]] = dag_zc_zp
